title: Found a way to escape Mallworld security
content: Last night was another Mallworld dream. This time, I got the feeling I was crashing a wedding reception being held at the mall. I was looking for my friend Alyson, and I was entering the back rooms. A lot of people wearing white dresses and tuxedos seemed upset I was walking through and the one woman dressed as a bride shouted, "Who are you? I don't recognize you! You're ruining everything!". At this point, grey uniformed guards with Mall Security on the front left pocket entered and started looking for me. Not wishing to be caught, I left the mall but they pursued me. I found a wooded park located behind a gas station and under some of the trees were people sitting under the tree, asleep. "That's how I get out!", I thought to myself and I found a tree, sat down, and went to sleep. I immediately woke up in my bed. So if mall security is after you? Find a spot, and fall asleep in the dream. You'll wake up in this world. Oh, and if it was anyone's here dream wedding that I interrupted? I apologize lol 🙂
